body:
Follow-up to robofab-sliprate and robofab-liftload. Sweeps MuJoCo `impratio` (1 to 1000) for a bar held at one end: creep falls about as 1/impratio; from impratio 10 the 1 and 5 degree tolerances give forces within 26%; MuJoCo needs 0.67-1.17x the old uniform-pressure bracket's lower bound and 1.15-1.67x a point-contact bound built on the contact layout MuJoCo reports. Stylised, preliminary, one engine.

Checks: 8 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok; README bullet and projects.json entry added; numbers in README checked against experiments/results.txt. Only reference is MuJoCo (Todorov et al. 2012), carried over from liftload.
